# ==============================================================================
# 1. 安装并加载需要的R包
# ==============================================================================
# 首次运行时安装
install.packages(c("dplyr", "broom", "readr"))
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(readr)
# ==============================================================================
# 2. 导入数据
# ==============================================================================
file_path <- "C:/Users/PUMCYCZ/Desktop/data-1.csv"

my_data <- read.csv(
  file_path,
  header = TRUE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  check.names = FALSE
)
# 查看数据结构
str(my_data)
summary(my_data)
# ==============================================================================
# 3. 设置变量类型
# ==============================================================================
# 结局变量必须编码为：0=good，1=poor
my_data$outcome <- as.numeric(my_data$outcome)
# 分类变量转换为因子
my_data$sex       <- factor(my_data$sex, levels = c(0, 1),
                            labels = c("Female", "Male"))
my_data$SRF   <- factor(my_data$SRF, levels = c(0, 1),
                            labels = c("No", "Yes"))
my_data$IRF    <- factor(my_data$IRF, levels = c(0, 1),
                            labels = c("No", "Yes"))
my_data$Choroidalpachyvessels    <- factor(my_data$Choroidalpachyvessels, levels = c(0, 1),
                         labels = c("No", "Yes"))
my_data$AMDlikefeatures <- factor(my_data$AMDlikefeatures, levels = c(0, 1),
                                            labels = c("No", "Yes"))
my_data$Massivehemorrhage <- factor(my_data$Massivehemorrhage, levels = c(0, 1),
                                            labels = c("No", "Yes"))
my_data$AntiVEGFagents  <- factor(my_data$AntiVEGFagents, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                                            labels = c("aflibercept", "ranibizumab", "conbercept"))

# 连续变量如不需要转换

# ==============================================================================
# 4. 单因素 Logistic 回归
# ==============================================================================
# 需要进行单因素分析的自变量
variables <- c(
  "Averageage",
  "sex",
  "CRT",
  "SFCT",
  "MaximumPEDheight", 
  "SRF",
  "IRF",
  "Choroidalpachyvessels",
  "AMDlikefeatures",
  "Massivehemorrhage",
  "AntiVEGFagents"
)

# 循环进行单因素 Logistic 回归
univ_results <- lapply(variables, function(var) {
  
  formula_univ <- as.formula(
    paste("outcome ~", var)
  )
  
  model_univ <- glm(
    formula_univ,
    data = my_data,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
  
  if (var == "AntiVEGFagents") {
    
    overall_test <- drop1(
      model_univ,
      test = "LRT"
    )
    
    overall_p <- overall_test[
      "AntiVEGFagents",
      "Pr(>Chi)"
    ]
    
    result <- data.frame(
      term = "AntiVEGFagents_overall",
      estimate = NA,
      conf.low = NA,
      conf.high = NA,
      p.value = overall_p,
      variable = var
    )
    
  } else {
    
    # 其他变量按照原来的方法输出
    result <- tidy(
      model_univ,
      exponentiate = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      mutate(variable = var)
  }
  
  return(result)
})

# 合并所有单因素回归结果
univ_table <- bind_rows(univ_results) %>%
  select(
    variable,
    term,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Variable = variable,
    Term = term,
    OR = estimate,
    CI_low = conf.low,
    CI_high = conf.high,
    P_value = p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OR = round(OR, 3),
    CI_low = round(CI_low, 3),
    CI_high = round(CI_high, 3),
    P_value = ifelse(P_value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                     sprintf("%.3f", P_value))
  )

# 查看结果
print(univ_table)

# 导出结果
write.csv(
  univ_table,
  "C:/Users/PUMCYCZ/Desktop/univariate_logistic.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
# ==============================================================================
# 5. 多因素 Logistic 回归
# ==============================================================================
multi_model <- glm(
  outcome ~ Averageage + SFCT + SRF + Choroidalpachyvessels + AMDlikefeatures +Massivehemorrhage,
  data = my_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# 查看原始模型结果
summary(multi_model)

# 提取OR、95%CI和P值
multi_table <- tidy(
  multi_model,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  select(
    term,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Variable = term,
    OR = estimate,
    CI_low = conf.low,
    CI_high = conf.high,
    P_value = p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OR = round(OR, 3),
    CI_low = round(CI_low, 3),
    CI_high = round(CI_high, 3),
    P_value = ifelse(P_value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                     sprintf("%.3f", P_value))
  )

print(multi_table)

# 导出结果
write.csv(
  multi_table,
  "C:/Users/PUMCYCZ/Desktop/multivariable_logistic.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
